title: Grin and Bear It
description: Temba Wide-Arm, a Nord mill owner in Ivarstead, despises bears for ruining her lumber business by scratching up tree trunks. She offers a reward if you bring her ten bear pelts to thin out the bear population.

base_facts: I own the lumber mill in Ivarstead and have sunk all my money into it.
I hate bears—they scratch up the tree trunks and ruin the lumber.
I complain about bears to anyone who will listen.

LEARN_TEMBAS_BEAR_PROBLEM: This person knows about my bear problem and how the bears are destroying my trees.
ACCEPT_BEAR_PELT_QUEST: This person agreed to bring me ten bear pelts to help thin out the bears.
RETURN_WITH_BEAR_PELTS: This person actually brought me ten bear pelts—I'm genuinely surprised anyone came through for me.
I rewarded them with a leveled enchanted war axe for thinning out the bear population.
My disposition toward this person has improved—they helped my lumber business when no one else would.
With fewer bears scratching up the tree trunks, my mill might finally turn a profit.

beats.comment: Player learns about Temba's bear problem and her need for pelts.
Player accepts the quest to gather 10 bear pelts for Temba.
Player returns with 10 bear pelts and completes the quest.
